paragraphs: I'm a backend-focused engineer who thrives in fast-paced environments where technical depth meets business impact. I started my career as a fresher at Gradeup (India's largest online competitive exam platform, serving 25M+ students), where I grew into a Staff Engineer & Backend Lead — building the backend architecture from the ground up, leading a team of 10+, and owning critical systems like payments, access control, and content delivery. Gradeup was acquired by Byju's for ~$50M in 2021 and rebranded as Byju's Exam Prep.

I then joined Eventbrite (NYSE-listed, ~88M monthly active users, 270M+ tickets processed annually) where I architect and deliver high-impact features — from AI-powered chatbot integrations that reduce support volume by 60%, to checkout flow optimizations that contributed to $2M+ in creator retention.
I'm passionate about distributed systems, clean architecture, and mentoring engineers. I believe the best code is the code that scales — both technically and organizationally.

bullets: Led architecture and delivery of a multi-slot time selection system for recurring events, coordinating across 3 engineering teams — decreased checkout abandonment by ~3% and contributed to $2M+ creator retention.
Designed a service to replace sequential service orchestration, reducing latency at scale — reduced API latency by 70%, enabling SLA-compliant, scalable checkout flows.
Designed and deployed AI chatbot integration (Decagon.ai), aiming to reduce support contact volume by ~60% and improving customer satisfaction by ~30%.
Built trust signals and credibility badges using historical event data — increased conversion rate by ~4% and boosted overall engagement.
Architected a high-throughput feedback and rating system for scalable event and organizer insights.
Led migration from monolithic systems to AWS-based microservices for improved scalability and fault tolerance.
Implemented zero-downtime CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI) for faster, safer releases.
Authored unit, E2E, and smoke tests for critical workflows, improving release confidence.
Partnered with product, design, and global stakeholders (US & Spain) to align roadmaps.

testimonials.text: Unnati joined us as fresher and left as backend lead. She was our "Miss Dependable" at Gradeup. You can give her a project and forget about it. You will be pleasantly surprised by a solution that not only worked flawlessly but also covered edge cases most people wouldn't have even thought of. She was our go to person whenever we have to pick critical or complex projects at the company. She is very comfortable working in situations with ambiguity which helped us move faster at Gradeup. She made everyone's job easier be it Product, QA Frontend devs and of course her own backend team. Any company would be fortunate to have her.
testimonials.name: Sanjeev Kumar

testimonials.text: While leading backend implementations at Gradeup, Unnati was known across the teams as dependable, kind, and efficient. Unnati's ability to handle ambiguity and develop resilient solutions for evolving problems was unmatched. She had joined the org as a fresher, but evolved into a kind rockstar everyone in the org looked up to. I recall Unnati owning and guiding the team in building / managing solutions around varied set of problems, like payments, mock tests, content operations, DB Migrations and CRM integrations. With her adaptability, professionalism, approachability, and exceptional skills, I would highly recommend her as a lead figure for high impact teams that are constantly learning and growing.
